Name: Benaiah, Son of Jehoiada
Summary: Benaiah, son of Jehoiada, was a valiant man of Kabzeel who slew two lionlike men of Moab, killed a lion in a pit on a snowy day, and slew a great Egyptian with his own spear. David set him over his guard.
KeyStory: Benaiah killed lions in pits, giants with their own spears, and two lionlike men of Moab.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 8:18; 2 Samuel 23:20; 2 Samuel 23:21; 2 Samuel 23:22; 2 Samuel 23:23; 1 Kings 1:8; 1 Kings 2:34; 1 Chronicles 11:22; 1 Chronicles 18:17
RelatedPeople: King David; Jehoiada, Father of Benaiah; Joab; King Solomon; Joab, Son of Zeruiah
LifeLesson: Courage in pits and snow is the same courage that guards a throne.
